title: CoreWeave Fully Connected 2026 (Moscone South, SF) — Sep 29–Oct 1

notes: CoreWeave's own customer/product conference, ~6 weeks before the est. 2026-11-10 Q3 print — the one company-controlled news venue inside the pre-print window. Discovered during the crwv-2026-11-10-print pulse-check adjacency sweep and filed `estimate` there (this lane never self-confirms an event in the PR that discovers it); flipped to `confirmed` by the initial research 2026-08-31 on the company primary plus the venue-operator corroboration.
